summary: All 7 targets (eps 13-19, S2 front) promoted to exact per-episode records from the fandom wiki's page-level 'Adapted Chapters' lists, corroborated by programming-cafe's independent Japanese table and Wikipedia's season-2 page (states S2 adapts vols 8-14, chs 70-139; episode summaries match the assignments). The zone is compression-heavy rather than deeply reordered: eps 13-17 run essentially linearly 70-100 with page-level cuts, then ep18 ('Ani Nekko' = ch 75's Japanese title) backfills the kane-mochi/203-Hill flashback bulk of 75-76 (whose present-day frames ep13 carried) behind a ch 102 (p.2-5) frame, and ep19 stitches Shiton-arc fragments (108, 113, 114) with backfill of 101 and 103 (Koito/anglerfish nabe). The skipped bulk goes to the OVAs already on record (OVA 2: 83 p.15-16, 84, 85 p.1-14; OVA 4: 108-113; OVA 5: 102, 104-107), while chs 88-89 and 96 (and most of 114 and 119) are adapted nowhere at all. Bonus: fandom's ep21 page refines the stored '~120-124' to include the 118 tail and 119 fragments (filed as a repair).

anchors.note: S2 opener 'Edogai-kun' (ch 72 'Edogai'): fandom lists 70-76; pcafe rounds to 71-74 (its ch-70-to-OVA-3 claim was already rejected in batch 14 - OVA 3 = 63-69 - and Wikipedia says S2 starts at ch 70). Ep13 carries only the present-day frames of 75-76 (Inkarmat's arrival/betrayal prophecy, Tanigaki's departure, the Tsurumi-Inkarmat reveal = ch 76's end, confirmed by Wikipedia's 'secretly working for Tsurumi'); the kane-mochi/203-Hill flashback bulk is held for ep18.

'Fakes' (ch 77 'Imitation'): Yubari mine chase, Edogai's death in the explosions = ch 81 'Destroying Evidence' p.2-13 (Wikipedia summary agrees the explosion is in ep14). pcafe rounds the seam (77-80 / 80-81); fandom's page split wins. Ends mid-81.

Title = ch 86 'Let's Talk About the Old Days'. Heavy compression: 83 p.11-18 / 84 / 85 p.1-16 skipped by TV (OVA 2 carries 83 p.15-16, 84, 85 p.1-14), chs 88-89 skipped entirely and adapted nowhere, 90 only partial. pcafe agrees (81-83, 86-87, 90, skipping 84-85 and 88-89).

Episode title = ch 97's title, but ep16 shows only 97 p.5-12 as the infiltration-plan setup/look-ahead and ep17 adapts 97 in full, so END = 95 (pcafe: 91-95; ep36/201-teaser precedent). Ch 96 'Clairvoyance' is skipped entirely (adapted nowhere); 91 p.1-16 also unadapted.

'Inside the Belly': Koito kills Suzukawa (98 'Satsuma Hayato'), hydrogen airship escape (99 'Airship'), Daisetsuzan pursuit (100). Fandom lists 97 unqualified here (full adaptation despite ep16's p.5-12 preview); pcafe: 97-100.

'Ani Nekko' = ch 75's Japanese title (阿仁根っ子). Opens on a ch 102 frame (p.2-5, group sets out for Abashiri), then backfills the Tanigaki Matagi flashback that is the bulk of 75-76 (kane mochi, Aoyama, 203 Hill - matches ch 75/76 synopses and Wikipedia's summary). Both sources agree on the set {75, 76, 102}. END = 102 as the frame/position instrument (ep32 precedent); the Lightning Bandit/O-Gin bulk of 102 + 104-107 goes to OVA 5. Non-monotonic by design (101 still unseen).

'Kamuy Hopunire' ceremony episode: Shiton-arc fragments (Ryu joins = 108 p.11-12, fandom-only 2-page fragment; kotan/ceremony = 113 p.11-19, 114 p.4-6 - the arc's bulk 108-113 is OVA 4 material) then non-monotonic backfill of Koito being scolded (101 p.10-18) and the anglerfish-nabe Ogata reveal (103 p.5-15, matches Wikipedia's summary). pcafe agrees on 101, 103, 113-114. END = 114 (furthest mainline, both sources); START = 113 (first corroborated substantial block; the 108 fragment is fandom-only).

repairs.why: Fandom's Episode_21 page-level list refines the stored approximate range: the episode opens by finishing 118 (p.16-18) and uses 4 pages of 119 before running 120-124. start_chapter 120 (first full chapter), end 124, vol 13 all unchanged - precision repair only. 119 p.4-8/10-18 is otherwise unadapted.

flags_for_sean: Ch 70 edge: fandom (ep13 = 70-76) + Wikipedia ('S2 adapts vols 8-14, chapters 70-139') put ch 70 in ep13; programming-cafe credits 70 to OVA 3 instead (a claim batch 14 already rejected - OVA 3 = 63-69). Kept start=70 for ep13.

Eps 13-19's generic 'rearranged {70-114} anchor at 21' zone annotations can be retired in favor of these per-episode records; eps 14 and 17 turned out plainly linear (no annotation needed), the rest carry the specific annotations above.

Never-adapted material inside the zone (no TV, no OVA): chs 88-89, ch 96, plus page gaps (90 p.7-16, 91 p.1-16, most of 114, 119 p.4-18 outside p.1-3/9). No source contradicts - the S2 front is compression, not just reorder.
ep18 END=102 follows the ep32 frame-as-position-instrument precedent; if the pipeline prefers the episode's bulk, END would be 76 (v8). Both sources agree on the chapter set either way.
ep19's opening 108 (p.11-12) fragment is fandom-only (programming-cafe lists 101, 103, 113-114); kept in chapters_adapted with START at the corroborated 113.
